anomalies.description: A white semi-truck entering the intersection from the left loses control, tips onto its side, and collides with a silver SUV stopped at the traffic light, causing significant deformation of the SUV's rear and side. Debris is scattered across the road, and a red sedan is also involved or impacted in the aftermath.
A dark-colored SUV in the left lane suddenly swerves right and flips onto its side, colliding with or near another vehicle during heavy traffic on a highway.

A white sedan in front of the dashcam vehicle suddenly swerves left and collides with a large semi-trailer truck that is crossing or merging into the lane, resulting in a violent impact that sends debris flying and causes the sedan to be pushed sideways under the trailer.

A white sedan overtakes on the right and collides with the rear-right side of a large semi-trailer truck, causing the truck to jackknife violently while the sedan is pushed sideways and sustains heavy rear damage.

A white sedan collides with the rear-right side of a large semi-trailer truck on a highway, causing visible damage to the sedan's rear and right side, and debris scattering. The truck is pushed sideways but remains upright; the sedan is forced off its lane and appears to spin or slide.

A black sedan collides with a white pickup truck at an intersection; the impact causes the pickup to rotate sharply left and its front end lifts off the ground.; A white pickup truck collides violently with a dark SUV in the left lane, causing the SUV to flip onto its side and eject debris; the impact occurs just after the intersection while traffic is stopped at a red light.

A green semi-trailer truck loses control in heavy rain, jackknifes, and overturns onto its side, colliding with a red passenger car that is directly behind it. The trailer slides across the wet road surface, crushing or trapping the car beneath it.
